title: AIDGO: A FAIR, Ontology for Aligning the EU AI Act Data Governance Obligations with ISO/IEC Technical Standards
authors: Kuruvilla George Aiyankovil and David Lewis
Keywords: ontology engineering, EU AI Act, ISO 5259, legal-technical alignment, knowledge graph, SPARQL, SKOS, data governance, FAIR, compliance
alt_text: Research poster for AIDGO, an OWL 2 ontology mapping EU AI Act Article 10 onto ISO/IEC 5259-3:2025. Twelve numbered sections in three columns cover the problem, an ontology schema diagram, a four-phase methodology pipeline, the decision sequence, the alignment taxonomy, a worked example, competency questions and findings. The headline result, shown as a row of 17 colour-coded tiles, is that of 17 atomic Article 10 obligations only 2 are completely satisfied by the standard, 12 are partially satisfied and 3 have no aligned requirement.
